cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Approve the Harmless Version
cards.instruction: Get approval for a harmless version of your plan, then gradually reveal what that approval now commits them to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. May I put one extra chair in the hall?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Excellent. It's for the chair of my new tenants' committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I approved furniture, not a committee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then welcome to our first agenda item: what your chair authorises.

mechanism: A solicits a small assent while assuming authority over what that assent entails, treating later questions as invitations for A ruling.
confusable: Distinguish simple expansion of a plan from explicitly using B earlier harmless approval as the basis of a new commitment.
comparison: A hall chair becomes consent to host and answer a meeting; family tea becomes hosting obligations for additional relatives.
seedUse: Use canonical chair and tea seeds but replace prefixed assertions with actual control over the scope of consent; chair as furniture must remain distinct from chairperson.
